questions.question: What order does Nanami give?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: Nanami orders Ino to take the boys and lower the curtain preventing sorcerers from entering Shibuya Station

questions.question: Where is the curtain's caster likely hiding?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: The most likely place is for the curtain's caster is to be in the most obvious place in Shibuya: Shibuya Tower

questions.question: How do Ino and Yuji reach the top of the tower?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: Ino and Yuji take a direct route to the top of the tower by riding on top of Nue

questions.question: What happens to Awasaka from the wires?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: Awasaka drops forty-one stories straight to the ground

questions.question: How does the battle begin?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: The battle begins on the expressway with Yuji landing a fierce left-handed body shot that lifts Awasaka out of the air from the impact

questions.question: What is Awasaka's technique?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: Megumi reveals to Yuji that their opponent's technique is Inverse, allowing the user to make strong attacks weak and vise versa

questions.question: How do they counter Inverse?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: In order to counter it, they must attack with a strong hit and a weak one at the same time

questions.question: How does Toad damage Awasaka?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: Yuji's punch is nullified but Toad's tongue does serious damage to Awasaka's lower left torso, enough so to draw blood from his mouth

questions.question: How does Yuji finish the fight?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: He uses a weaker punch that's made incredibly strong by Awasaka's inverse, sending the old man violently spinning away from the impact

questions.question: What do Yuji and Megumi break?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: Yuji and Megumi break the two commissioned curtains, lowering the barrier preventing sorcerers from entering Shibuya Station

questions.question: What happens to Ino?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: Ino is in horrible shape. Ino isn't quite dead but he's severely injured and Yuji wants revenge

questions.question: Where does Yuji go?
questions.subject: Yuji Itadori & Megumi Fushiguro vs. Jiro Awasaka

answer.item: Yuji takes a deep breath to relax and decides to leave Ino to Megumi while going to Shibuya Station himself
